test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following figure is a combination of 4 figures, A (rhombus), B (triangle), C (circle) and D (heart). Figure A represents number of people who like to read classical novels. Figure B represents people who like to read fictional novels. Figure C and D represents people who like to read biographies and fantasy novels, respectively. How many people like to read only biographies or only classical novels?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/497daaca70bfe721ca858203ddbfa3a6b8c37aee309dc5c75ec355d907044993.png]
solution:
The region that best represents the number of people who like to read only biographies or only classical novels is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1e83538ef5b92f8f632cec00472b66b9277805583f305580b2be250def55256.png] 

Here, the marked area shows the number of people who like to read only biographies or only classical novels.

So, the number of people who like to read only biographies or only classical novels ⇒ (2 + 10) = 12

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
